The scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, with Path 1 having a slightly higher score. The shared target of Mollicellin N across both paths reinforces the possibility of a common mechanism of action. However, the evidence is limited to the observed targets and does not provide direct evidence of the compound's mode of action on MZ1-PC. The integration of these findings suggests a possible role for 3Beta-Hydroxyolean-12-En-23,29-Dioic Acid in modulating MZ1-PC through the Uchl5 pathway, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm this relationship.
